correctness.rationale: Fourier adjacency eigendecomposition was reconstructed; strict parity-monotonicity gives a single two-cosine unit-gap equation. Conway–Jones Theorem 7 eliminates all irrational unit-gap pairs, and the rational cases yield precisely m=2 mod 4 or m=3 mod 6. The detector eigenbasis ranks (one or two sinks) yield exact limiting mixed-state absorption via dissipativity, while equal-energy spectral projections yield the coherent averages and correction factors. All boundary cases m>=3, J nonzero, and absorber strengths strictly positive are handled analytically. The included full executable verifier checks exact cyclotomic collisions and rational formulas for 28 values, detector ranks in 24 cases and no-jump dynamics in four; these finite observations are not used as infinite proof.
